ps.en: Demonstrating high artificial [[intelligence]], an [[intelligent]] system produced [[intelligible]] code summaries that helped developers [[polish]] every key [[point]]. Innovative engines began to [[propel]] automated tools to handle [[proper]] data structures across corporate [[property]].
ps.zh: 展现出高超的人工智能，智能系统输出了清晰易懂的代码总结，帮助开发人员精雕细琢每一个要点。创新的引擎开始推动自动化工具，跨公司财产处理适当的数据结构。

ps.en: Maintaining a balanced [[proportion]] of resources, the board submitted a formal [[proposal]] to [[propose]] a new commercial [[proposition]]. Assessing future market [[prospects|prospect]], [[prospective]] investors followed standard security [[protocol]] to find a [[proximate]] solution and [[restore]] system stability.
ps.zh: 保持平衡的资源比例，董事会提交了一份正式提案以提出一项新的商业主张。评估未来的市场前景，预期的投资者遵循标准安全协议以寻找切近的解决方案并恢复系统稳定性。

ps.en: Regulators agreed to [[restrain]] impulsive spending, placing strict [[restraint]] on market speculation so as not to [[restrict]] genuine growth. Developers decided to [[attach]] new clauses before competitors launched an [[attack]] on their market share.
ps.zh: 监管者同意抑制冲动支出，对市场投机施加严格约束，以免限制真实增长。开发商决定在竞争对手对其市场份额发起攻击前附加新条款。

ps.en: Striving to [[attain]] excellence, executives made an [[attempt]] to [[attend]] the summit, paying full [[attention]] to policy trends. Adopting a positive [[attitude]], they refused to [[attribute]] success purely to luck.
ps.zh: 努力取得卓越，高管们尝试参加峰会，全神贯注于政策趋势。采取积极的态度，他们拒绝将成功纯粹归因于运气。

ps.en: Appearing before the supreme [[court]], attorneys acted with flawless [[courtesy]]. They moved to [[cover]] risk, [[create]] new jobs, foster a [[creative]] team, and earn international [[credit]].
ps.zh: 出庭最高法院，律师们表现出无可挑剔的谦恭礼貌。他们采取行动规避涵盖风险、创造新岗位、培养有创意的团队并赢得国际声誉信用。

stories.zh: 人道主义危机与政策暴露

ps.en: During a sudden financial [[crisis]], leaders took action to [[drive]] economic reform and restrict illicit [[drug]] trade. Expanding foreign [[exports|export]], analysts warned against policies that [[expose]] domestic markets to excessive [[exposure]].
ps.zh: 在突然的金融危机期间，领导人采取行动驱动经济改革并限制非法毒品交易。扩大对外出口，分析师警告不要采取使国内市场暴露出过度风险暴露的政策。

ps.en: Officials wished to [[express]] deep concern through a formal [[expression]]. They sought to [[extend]] aid networks, plan an [[extension]] of services, conduct an [[extensive]] review, and measure the full [[extent]] of damages.
ps.zh: 官员们希望通过正式声明表达深切关切。他们试图延伸救援网络，规划服务拓展，开展广泛的审查，并测量全部损害程度。

ps.en: Preserving basic [[human]] dignity, the global campaign served all [[humanity]] with a [[humble]] attitude, fully [[intending|intend]] to realize its noble [[intention]].
ps.zh: 维护基本的人类尊严，这项全球运动以谦逊的态度服务于全人类，完全意图实现其高尚的意图。

ps.en: Faced with [[intense]] competition, researchers raised the [[intensity]] of their [[intensive]] study to [[interact]] smoothly through international [[intercourse]]. Driven by genuine [[interest]], they renovated the [[interior]] space to support [[internal]] operational needs across an [[international]] network.
ps.zh: 面对激烈的竞争，研究人员提升了集中精细研究的强度，以通过国际交流顺畅互动。在真实兴趣的驱动下，他们整修了内部空间，以支持国际网络中的内部运营需求。

ps.en: Scholars gathered to [[interpret]] complex legal codes without fearing to [[lose]] face or suffer financial [[loss]]. Even when market rates reached a [[low]] point, managers chose to [[lower]] entry costs to launch a [[lucrative]] business model.
ps.zh: 学者们聚集在一起解读复杂的法律法规，而不必担心丢面子或遭受财务损失。即使在市场利率跌至低点时，管理者仍选择降低进入成本以推出盈利丰厚的商业模式。

ps.en: The high-stakes trial tested every [[nerve]], leaving negotiators [[nervous]], but [[nevertheless]] they reached a historic compromise.
ps.zh: 这场高风险的审判考验着神经，让谈判代表感到紧张不安，但尽管如此他们依然达成了历史性的妥协。

words.exam: 智力；智慧；情报；情报人员
words.dif: intelligence 指人的智力思维能力，或军事安全部门的情报。
words.pat: Artificial intelligence is reshaping modern diagnostic medicine.
words.patZh: 人工智能正在重塑现代诊断医学。

words.dif: intelligent 侧重具有高智商、理解力强或具备智能化功能。
words.pat: The university recruits highly intelligent students from around the globe.
words.patZh: 该大学从全球招募智商极高的聪明学生。

words.dif: intelligible 侧重语言、文理清晰表达明确容易听懂理解。
words.pat: The professor made complex quantum concepts easily intelligible to beginners.
words.patZh: 教授使复杂的量子概念对初学者来说简单易懂。

c: polish a draft 润色草案
words.dif: polish 指物理上擦亮抛光，或对文章言论精雕细琢润色。
words.pat: She spent hours attempting to polish her academic thesis before submission.
words.patZh: 她在提交前花了数小时试图润色她的学术论文。

words.dif: point 指具体的要点、分数、尖端，或用手指指方向。
words.pat: The speaker raised a valid point during the parliamentary debate.
words.patZh: 演讲者在议会辩论期间提出了一个有效的要点。

words.dif: propel 侧重施加机械力或动力推着物体前进。
words.pat: Strong winds helped propel the sailboat across the turbulent bay.
words.patZh: 强风有助于推进帆船穿过动荡的海湾。

words.dif: proper 指符合规范礼仪、标准或特定场合要求的。
words.pat: Wearing proper safety gear is mandatory inside the construction site.
words.patZh: 在施工现场内部穿戴适当的安全装备是强制性的。

words.dif: property 指依法拥有的地产财产，或物质的物理化学性质。
words.pat: Protecting intellectual property is essential for encouraging innovation.
words.patZh: 保护知识产权对于鼓励创新至关重要。

c: in proportion to 与…成比例
words.dif: proportion 指整体中各部分所占的数量比例关系。
words.pat: A high proportion of the company's revenue is reinvested in research.
words.patZh: 公司收入的很大比例被重新投资于研究。

c: submit a proposal 提交提案
words.dif: proposal 指正式书面提交供讨论审议决定的提议方案。
words.pat: The committee reviewed the budget proposal submitted by the department.
words.patZh: 委员会审查了该部门提交的预算提案。

c: propose a plan 提议一个计划
propose a toast 提议干杯
words.dif: propose 指正式提出方案看法，或向人求婚。
words.pat: The government plans to propose new legislation on renewable energy.
words.patZh: 政府计划就可再生能源提出新立法。

c: testing a proposition 检验命题
words.dif: proposition 侧重在逻辑论证或商业谈判中陈述的论题主张。
words.pat: The entrepreneur presented an attractive business proposition to investors.
words.patZh: 创业者向投资者展示了一项极具吸引力的商业主张。

c: prospect for oil 勘探石油
words.dif: prospect 指对未来发展的期望前途，或地质勘探。
words.pat: Job prospects for software engineers remain exceptionally strong.
words.patZh: 软件工程师的就业前景依然格外强劲。

words.dif: prospective 指在将来有可能成为客户、买家或学生的。
words.pat: The real estate agent invited prospective buyers to inspect the house.
words.patZh: 房地产经纪人邀请预期的买家看房。

words.exam: 礼仪；外交协议；网络协议
words.dif: protocol 指外交场合的正式礼仪规则，或计算机网络通信协议。
words.pat: Strict diplomatic protocol was observed during the presidential reception.
words.patZh: 在总统招待会期间遵循了严格的外交礼仪。

words.exam: 最接近的；切近的；直接的
words.dif: proximate 指在时间、空间或因果关系上最切近直接的。
words.pat: Careless driving was determined as the proximate cause of the collision.
words.patZh: 疏忽驾驶被认定为碰撞的直接原因。

words.dif: restore 侧重使受损、破坏的状态或信心重新回到原先的良好水平。
words.pat: The new policy helped restore public confidence in the banking system.
words.patZh: 新政策有助于恢复公众对银行体系的信心。

c: restrain sb from doing 制止某人做…
words.dif: restrain 侧重用意志力或物理手段强制压制情绪或行为。
words.pat: Police worked quickly to restrain the unruly crowd at the stadium.
words.patZh: 警方迅速采取行动制止体育场内失控的人群。

words.dif: restraint 指保持沉着冷静的自我约束克制，或管束措施。
words.pat: Diplomats urged all parties to exercise maximum restraint during crisis.
words.patZh: 外交官们敦促各方在危机期间保持最大程度的克制。

words.dif: restrict 侧重依法规制度划定明确界限加以约束限制。
words.pat: The regulation aims to restrict access to sensitive military records.
words.patZh: 该规定旨在限制对敏感军事记录的调阅。

c: attach a file 附加文件
words.dif: attach 指将某物系在或贴在另一物上，或表示重视。
words.pat: Remember to attach your updated resume to the job application email.
words.patZh: 请记得将您更新后的简历附在求职申请电子邮件中。

words.dif: attack 指武力进攻、言论抨击，或疾病突然发作。
words.pat: The army launched a surprise attack on the enemy stronghold.
words.patZh: 军队对敌方据点发动了突然袭击。

c: attain a goal 达成目标
words.dif: attain 侧重经过长期不懈努力达成宏大目标或成就。
words.pat: She worked diligently for years to attain a doctorate in astrophysics.
words.patZh: 她勤奋工作多年以取得天体物理学博士学位。

c: make an attempt 作出尝试
words.dif: attempt 侧重付出努力尝试去做具有挑战性的事情。
words.pat: The climber made a bold attempt to reach the mountain summit.
words.patZh: 登山者做出了攀登山峰顶峰的大胆尝试。

c: attend a meeting 出席会议
words.dif: attend 指亲自到场出席活动，或专心照顾某人。
words.pat: Delegates from over fifty nations will attend the annual climate conference.
words.patZh: 来自五十多个国家的代表将出席年度气候会议。

words.dif: attention 指将心思精力集中关注于某一特定事物。
words.pat: Please pay close attention to the safety demonstration before take-off.
words.patZh: 起飞前请密切注意安全示范。

words.dif: attitude 指对人对事所持的心态观点或行为姿态。
words.pat: Maintaining a constructive attitude helps resolve workplace disputes quickly.
words.patZh: 保持建设性的态度有助于快速解决工作场所的争议。

c: attribute A to B 把A归因于B
words.dif: attribute 作动词指归因于，作名词指特征属性。
words.pat: Scientists attribute global warming largely to human carbon emissions.
words.patZh: 科学家们很大程度上把全球变暖归因于人类的碳排放。

words.dif: court 指进行审判的民事刑事法庭，或体育球场。
words.pat: The case will be presented before the supreme court next Monday.
words.patZh: 该案件将于下周一在最高法院出庭审理。

c: by courtesy of 蒙…惠赠/允许
words.dif: courtesy 指行为举止中展现的高雅谦恭与文明礼貌。
words.pat: Show common courtesy by waiting for others to finish speaking.
words.patZh: 通过等待他人说完话来展现基本的谦恭礼貌。

words.exam: 覆盖；涵盖；包含；掩盖；封面
fam: coverage n. 覆盖率；新闻报道
words.dif: cover 指物理上遮盖，或在范围上包含涵盖某费用议题。
words.pat: The medical insurance policy will cover all hospitalization expenses.
words.patZh: 医疗保险单将涵盖所有的住院费用。

words.dif: create 侧重从无到有建立或构想出新的事物价值。
words.pat: The investment initiative aims to create thousands of sustainable jobs.
words.patZh: 这项投资倡议旨在创造数以千计的可持续就业机会。

words.dif: creative 描写具有丰富想象力和创新设计思维的。
words.pat: Engineers need creative problem-solving skills to overcome complex technical design challenges.
words.patZh: 工程师需要有创意的解决问题技能来克服复杂的技术设计挑战。

words.exam: 信用；信誉；赞扬；学分；归功于
c: give credit to 赞扬/归功于
words.dif: credit 指财务信用，或对成就的公开赞扬归功。
words.pat: Her tireless dedication earned her full credit for the project's success.
words.patZh: 她不懈的奉献为她赢得了该项目成功的充分赞扬与归功。

words.dif: crisis 特指面临严重危险混乱的决定性紧要关头。
words.pat: Governments must act decisively during an economic crisis.
words.patZh: 政府必须在经济危机期间果断采取行动。

words.exam: 驾驶；驱动；推进；运动；干劲
fam: driver n. 驾驶员；驱动因素
words.dif: drive 指驾驶车辆，或在物理力量动机上驱使向前。
words.pat: Technological innovation continues to drive economic productivity worldwide.
words.patZh: 技术创新继续驱动着全球经济生产力。

words.dif: drug 既指治病用的医学处方药，也指成瘾违禁毒品。
words.pat: Strict laws regulate the manufacturing and distribution of prescription drugs.
words.patZh: 严格的法律监管着处方药的生产与分销。

words.dif: export 指将本国商品技术销售输出到国外（与 import 相对）。
words.pat: Agricultural produce forms a major part of the country's total export volume.
words.patZh: 农产品构成了该国总出口量的主要部分。

c: expose to danger 使暴露于危险
words.dif: expose 侧重使隐藏的欺诈事实暴露出光，或置于危险中。
words.pat: Investigative reporters worked to expose corruption within the regulatory agency.
words.patZh: 调查记者致力于揭露监管机构内部的腐败。

c: exposure to radiation 暴露于辐射
words.dif: exposure 指置身于某种环境风险中的状态，或媒体曝光报道。
words.pat: Prolonged exposure to direct sunlight can cause skin damage.
words.patZh: 长期暴露于阳光直射下会造成皮肤损害。

words.dif: express 作动词指清楚表达想法感情，作形容词指特快明确的。
words.pat: The ambassador stepped forward to express sincere condolences to victims.
words.patZh: 大使走上前去向受害者表达诚挚的哀悼。

c: freedom of expression 表达自由
words.dif: expression 指思想情感的表达方式，或脸上的喜怒表情。
words.pat: Art offers a powerful medium for personal emotional expression.
words.patZh: 艺术为个人情感表达提供了一种强有力的媒介。

c: extend a deadline 延长截止日期
extend a welcome 表达欢迎
words.dif: extend 侧重在长度、时间、空间或范围上的延伸扩展。
words.pat: The university decided to extend the application deadline by one week.
words.patZh: 大学决定将申请截止日期延长一周。

words.exam: 延伸；拓展；电话分机；延期
c: grant an extension 给予延期
words.dif: extension 指增加的延伸部分、延定期限或电话分机号。
words.pat: He requested a two-day extension to finalize the research paper.
words.patZh: 他申请延期两天以完成研究论文。

words.dif: extensive 强调覆盖范围辽阔、领域广泛或数量巨大。
words.pat: The scientist conducted extensive field trials across three continents.
words.patZh: 这位科学家在三大洲开展了广泛的野外试验。

c: to some extent 在某种程度上
words.dif: extent 侧重影响、损害或范围所达到的具体程度。
words.pat: It is difficult to assess the full extent of the storm damage immediately.
words.patZh: 很难立即评估风暴损害的全盘程度。

words.dif: human 指与人类属性相关的，与动物机器相对。
words.pat: Human error was determined as the main factor in the accident.
words.patZh: 人为错误被判定为事故的主要因素。

words.exam: 人类；人性；人道；人文科学
c: crimes against humanity 反人类罪
study of humanity 人文研究
words.dif: humanity 指全人类的总称，或人道关怀同情心。
words.pat: Medical advancements have brought immense benefits to all humanity.
words.patZh: 医学进步给全人类带来了巨大福祉。

words.exam: 谦逊的；地位卑微的；使谦逊
words.dif: humble 侧重虚心谦逊不自傲，或出身普通卑微。
words.pat: Despite his brilliant success, he remained a remarkably humble scholar.
words.patZh: 尽管取得了辉煌的成功，他依然是一位格外谦逊的学者。

words.dif: intend 指心中计划打算达成某种目的或用途。
words.pat: We fully intend to complete the software upgrade by next month.
words.patZh: 我们完全打算在下个月前完成软件升级。

c: with the intention of 怀着…目的
words.dif: intention 指行动背后预先设立的具体目的意图。
words.pat: He signed the contract with the clear intention of expanding the business.
words.patZh: 他签署合同怀有明确拓展业务的意图。

words.exam: 剧烈的；激烈的；强烈的；热情的
words.dif: intense 强调感情、痛楚、竞争在程度上的剧烈强烈。
words.pat: Athletes faced intense heat during the marathon race.
words.patZh: 运动员们在马拉松赛跑期间面对酷热。

c: intensity of light 光照强度
words.dif: intensity 物理学或抽象意义上测量的力量、情感强度水平。
words.pat: The hurricane increased in intensity as it approached the coast.
words.patZh: 当飓风逼近海岸时，其强度不断增加。

c: labor intensive 劳动密集型的
words.dif: intensive 侧重短时间内投入大量资源开展的精细集中行动。
words.pat: Students completed an intensive course in business English before traveling.
words.patZh: 学生们在出行前完成了一门商务英语集训课程。

words.exam: 相互作用；相互影响；交流
words.dif: interact 指两者或多方之间产生互相交流影响。
words.pat: Teachers encourage students to interact actively during class discussions.
words.patZh: 老师鼓励学生在课堂讨论期间积极互动。

words.dif: intercourse 指社会、国家、思想之间的正式往来交流。
words.pat: Freedom of trade promotes peaceful commercial intercourse between nations.
words.patZh: 贸易自由促进国家之间和平的商业往来。

words.exam: 兴趣；利益；利息；使感兴趣
c: in the interest of 为了…利益
words.dif: interest 作名词指兴趣求知欲、商业利益或贷款利息。
words.pat: Central banks raised the interest rate to curb runaway inflation.
words.patZh: 中央银行提高了利率以遏制失控的通胀。

words.exam: 内部；内地；内部的；内陆的
words.dif: interior 指建筑物、机构内部空间，或国家内陆地区（与 exterior 相对）。
words.pat: The interior design of the hotel combines modern and traditional elements.
words.patZh: 该酒店的室内设计融合了现代与传统元素。

words.dif: internal 强调机构、身体或系统内部的结构功能。
words.pat: The executive board ordered a thorough internal audit of financial accounts.
words.patZh: 执行董事会下令对财务账户进行彻底的内部审计。

words.dif: international 涉及两个或多个国家之间的交流关系。
words.pat: The summit brought together leaders from across the international community.
words.patZh: 峰会汇聚了来自整个国际社会的领导人。

words.exam: 解释；说明；口译；把…理解为
words.dif: interpret 侧重对数据、法律条文进行学术解说理解，或进行口译。
words.pat: Scholars gathered to interpret newly discovered ancient manuscripts.
words.patZh: 学者们聚集在一起解读新发现的古代手稿。

c: lose a job 失去工作
words.dif: lose 侧重失去物品、比赛输掉或迷失方向。
words.pat: Companies stand to lose valuable clients if service quality declines.
words.patZh: 如果服务质量下降，公司面临失去宝贵客户的风险。

c: at a loss 茫然不知所措
words.dif: loss 指失去某物、亲人离世，或财务上的亏损赤字。
words.pat: Insurance covered the full financial loss caused by the factory fire.
words.patZh: 保险涵盖了由工厂火灾造成的全部财务损失。

words.dif: low 侧重位置矮、数量少、程度或价格低下。
words.pat: Engineers designed an energy-efficient home with extremely low power consumption.
words.patZh: 工程师设计了一栋具有极低功耗的节能住宅。

words.dif: lower 作动词指使高度、价格、音量降低变小。
words.pat: The bank voted to lower interest rates to stimulate business borrowing.
words.patZh: 银行投票决定降低利率以刺激企业借贷。

c: lucrative contract 盈利丰厚的合同
words.dif: lucrative 特指能产生巨额金钱利润的商业活动或合同。
words.pat: He abandoned his law practice to pursue a lucrative career in investment banking.
words.patZh: 他放弃了法律执业去从事投资银行这一盈利丰厚的职业。

words.exam: 神经；勇气；胆量；鼓起勇气
words.dif: nerve 指生理神经系统，或内心的胆量勇气。
words.pat: It takes immense nerve to step onto the international stage alone.
words.patZh: 独自走上国际舞台需要巨大的勇气。

words.exam: 神经紧张的；焦虑不安的；神经的
words.dif: nervous 描写因担心、恐惧而产生的心理紧张不安。
words.pat: She felt extremely nervous right before presenting her speech to the board.
words.patZh: 在向董事会展示演讲前她感到极其紧张不安。

c: nevertheless, he agreed 尽管如此，他同意了
nevertheless, he persevered 尽管如此，他仍坚持
words.dif: nevertheless 作转折副词，强调即使存在某种情况，后面的事实依然成立。
words.pat: The task was extraordinarily difficult; nevertheless, the team completed it on schedule.
words.patZh: 任务极其困难；尽管如此，团队依然按时完成了任务。
